name: stills-service
description: Stills bank, client galleries and non-destructive adjustments for Big Small TV, At Speed Productions and Serpentine Creative.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/recipe && tsc -p services && tsc -p web && tsc -p infra && tsc -p scripts
